summary.text: Isaac Contreras is an unaffiliated write-in candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Democrat Stephanie Vigil, Republican Jill Haffley and Libertarian John Hjersman.

paragraphs.text: Isaac Contreras earned a bachelor's degree from Georgia Southern University in 2016.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in Colorado for over a year.

He said he aims to lower the cost of living through more public transportation, improved healthcare and housing reform, and to protect the environment by limiting the size of data centers and expanding renewable energy.
